import urllib.request
import json

def search_ncbi_gene(symbol):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=gene&term={symbol}[Gene+Name]+AND+human[Organism]&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
